create_TorchProfiler: create a TorchProfiler instance with CPU and CUDA profiling activities and a custom schedule
start_TorchProfiler: start the TorchProfiler to begin recording CPU and CUDA profiling data
stop_TorchProfiler: stop the TorchProfiler to end recording and finalize trace output

review_TorchProfiler_init: review the TorchProfiler constructor to understand schedule parameters and tensorboard trace handler setup
